decision.basis: The SP01 card delivers technical facts, sourced version candidates, measurement methods, environment isolation and rollback boundaries. The user approved this bounded closeout after review.

downstreamGates.owner: SP05 prepares actual page, content and segment duration; SP35 performs product evidence review
downstreamGates.trigger: Applicable product pages and content exist
downstreamGates.originalThreshold: 3 rounds per applicable device group; at least 30 timed segments per round with frozen segment duration and 200 records plus lawful heavy content; every segment averages at least 55 FPS and has no application-attributable jank over 100 ms; retain frame/input traces, long-frame details, per-segment statistics and recording.

downstreamGates.owner: SP01 defines measurement method; SP08, SP13 and SP31 gather endpoint evidence; SP35 reviews final budgets
downstreamGates.trigger: Actual product endpoints and suppliers exist
downstreamGates.originalThreshold: Per-endpoint UI/cloud/supplier latency and errors with approved budgets; record P50, P95, maximum, failures and unknown outcomes. Unapproved endpoint budgets remain blocked; AI, payment and verification do not inherit ordinary request budgets.
downstreamGates.failureBlocks: The affected endpoint integration and final product acceptance

downstreamGates.owner: SP01 records the network profile method; SP11 and applicable business cards test interruption recovery; SP35 reviews
downstreamGates.originalThreshold: Apply the frozen limit/latency/loss configuration before and after each applicable path for 3 rounds per scenario; preserve state and input and create no duplicate business effect; retain injection settings, request/object IDs, recovery video and all round results.
downstreamGates.failureBlocks: Affected business card and final product acceptance

downstreamGates.owner: SP05 defines product loop; measured memory budget is proposed for user confirmation; SP35 performs endurance evidence review
downstreamGates.trigger: Actual product pages and repeatable mixed-user loop exist
downstreamGates.originalThreshold: 60 minutes, at least 60 full cycles and a record every 10 minutes (user-confirmed workload); no crash, blank screen, uncaught exception or duplicate business effect; resource use must meet a user-confirmed measured budget with no sustained leak.

downstreamGates.owner: SP08 and other applicable product task cards; SP35 performs final cross-product review
downstreamGates.trigger: Private file, thumbnail, metadata, URL or authorization-revocation behavior exists in the product
downstreamGates.originalThreshold: After revocation, end or unlisting, backend denies unauthorized private-file reads; only lawful versions are public; metadata does not expose location; do not claim to revoke copies already saved by users. Retain before/after URL, authorization and version evidence.
downstreamGates.failureBlocks: Affected product card and final product acceptance

downstreamGates.owner: SP08/SP11/SP13 prepare isolated business-shaped data; SP35/SP36 perform and reconcile actual restoration
downstreamGates.trigger: Business records, relationships, permissions, funds, inventory, versions or messages exist
downstreamGates.originalThreshold: Restore an isolated backup containing unknown requests/funds/ads/coupons/reviews and reconcile relationships, authorization, funds, inventory, versions and messages; do not revive canceled/expired/revoked state or duplicate counts/refunds. Retain actual backup point, restore log, full-object reconciliation, rollback and retest evidence.
downstreamGates.failureBlocks: Applicable downstream tasks and final product acceptance

downstreamGates.owner: SP01-SP06 delivery owners; final gate review before SP07
downstreamGates.trigger: All SP01-SP06 deliverables and required confirmations are ready for aggregate review
downstreamGates.originalThreshold: Verify every SP01-SP06 prerequisite, task dependency, threshold, evidence record and required confirmation; unresolved parameters remain explicitly blocked and are not defaulted.
